summary: A calculated dataset type whose formula names a type the project does not have is now treated as a manual input everywhere, so the ResQ import keeps its values as hard-coded numbers you can edit.
details: Its datasets no longer carry a formula or precedents, are not read-only, are not refreshed by the dependent walk, and appear in the ResQ transfer review like any other input.
One shared rule now decides which dataset types ArcRho calculates itself, for the app, the ResQ import, and the transfer review alike.
